title: Every Sound Is a Vibration
description: Welcome to Echo Academy! Baron Mute has stolen the Harmony Bell and wrapped the world in silence. To reforge it, you must first discover the secret of every sound: vibration.

content.value: The Day the World Went Quiet

Maestra Sonata 🎵 gathers you, Anaya 👧 and Arjun 👦. 'Baron Mute has silenced everything,' she says. 'No music, no voices, no birdsong. Your first mission: find out what makes sound in the first place.'

Here is the big secret: SOUND IS PRODUCED BY VIBRATION. A vibration is a rapid to-and-fro (back-and-forth) motion. When any object vibrates, it makes sound. Stop the vibration and the sound stops instantly.
Touch your throat while you hum — you feel it buzzing. Pluck a guitar string and watch it shiver. Tap a drum and the skin trembles. In every case, something is vibrating.

OBJECT        WHAT VIBRATES
🥁  Drum       the stretched skin
🎸  Guitar     the plucked string
🔔  Bell       the metal body
🗣️  Voice      the vocal cords in your throat
📱  Speaker    the thin cone inside
Proof: touch a ringing bell and it stops ringing. Your hand stops the vibration — and the sound dies at once. No vibration, no sound.
Key Takeaway: Sound is produced by vibration — a rapid back-and-forth motion. Whenever an object vibrates it makes sound, and stopping the vibration stops the sound.
